rules.name: Project Architecture & Structure
rules.description: Enforce the established project structure and architectural patterns
rules: Always use the established folder structure: src/{components,pages,api,services,types,utils,hooks,test,contexts,mocks,theme}
Follow the component hierarchy: pages -> components -> ui -> design system
Use TypeScript strict mode with explicit typing; avoid 'any' unless absolutely necessary
Implement proper separation of concerns: UI components in components/, business logic in services/, data fetching in api/
Follow the established naming conventions: PascalCase for components, camelCase for functions/variables, kebab-case for files

rules.name: UI Design System & Apple-Inspired Design
rules.description: Enforce the Apple-inspired design system and UI patterns
rules: Use Tailwind CSS for all styling with the established design tokens from src/lib/constants/designSystem.ts
Follow the MTDRB Modal Specification: slide-in from right, max-w-4xl, clean white background, subtle shadows
Use Framer Motion for all animations with the established animation variants
Implement responsive design: mobile-first approach with proper breakpoints
Use the established color palette: mtdrb brand colors, semantic colors (success, warning, danger, info)
Apply consistent spacing: p-6 for sections, p-4 for cards, space-y-6 for content areas
Use rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-xl for buttons, rounded-lg for inputs
Implement proper dark mode support with dark: variants
Use React Icons (Feather icons) for all iconography

rules.name: Smart Component Usage
rules.description: Enforce the use of established Smart components and patterns
rules: Use SmartButton, SmartCard, KPICard from src/components/ui/DesignSystem.tsx for consistent UI
Use SmartKpiCard from src/components/ui/SmartKpiCard.tsx for KPI displays
Implement MTDRBModal for all modals following the specification in MTDRB_MODAL_SPECIFICATION.md
Use SmartTable for data tables with proper pagination, sorting, and filtering
Use SmartDashboardAnalytics for analytics components
Use FormSection, FormField, FormGrid from MTDRBModal for form layouts
Apply SmartLoading and EmptyState components for loading and empty states
Use the established animation variants from DesignSystem.tsx

rules.name: State Management & Context Usage
rules.description: Enforce proper state management patterns using React Context
rules: Use AuthContext for all authentication and user-related state
Use UIContext for UI state (tabs, loading, sidebar, theme)
Use ThemeContext for theme management (light/dark mode)
Use SubscriptionContext for subscription and billing state
Use PageThemeContext for page-specific theming
Implement proper error boundaries with ErrorBoundary component
Use useCallback and useMemo for expensive operations and event handlers
Avoid prop drilling; use context for shared state across components

rules.name: API & Service Layer
rules.description: Enforce proper API and service layer patterns
rules: Use the centralized api client from src/api/client.ts for all data operations
Implement proper error handling using src/services/errorHandler.ts
Use the mock Supabase client in development (src/supabaseClient.ts)
Follow the established API patterns: getAll, getById, create, update, delete
Use proper TypeScript interfaces for all API responses
Implement loading states for all async operations
Use the realtimeService for real-time features (check-ins, alerts, notifications)
Handle API errors with user-friendly messages using the error handler

rules.name: Modal System & MTDRB Specification
rules.description: Enforce the MTDRB Modal Specification for all modals
rules: All modals must use MTDRBModal component with slide-in from right animation
Implement proper modal structure: header, content, footer with sticky positioning
Use FormSection for organizing modal content into logical sections
Implement proper focus management and keyboard navigation
Use FormField for all form inputs with proper labels and validation
Implement proper modal closing: escape key, backdrop click, close button
Use the established modal styling from MODAL_STYLES in designSystem.ts
Implement proper form validation with error states and help text
